1.1: Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, tzarich sheyyomar, befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. rabban gamliel omer, af hammevi min harekem umin hacheger. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu mikkefar ludim lelod. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, ella hammevi mimmedinat hayyam vehammolich. vehammevi mimmedina limdina vimdinat hayyam, tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, afillu mehegmonya lehegmonya:
1.2: Rabbi yehuda omer, merekem lammizrach, verekem kammizrach. meashkelon laddarom, veashkelon kaddarom. meakko latztzafon, veakko katztzafon. rabbi meir omer, akko keeretz yisrael laggittin:
1.3: Hammevi get beeretz yisrael, eno tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. im yesh alav orrim, yitkayyem bechotmav. hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam veeno yachol lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, im yesh alav edim, yitkayyem bechotmav:
1.4: Echad gitte nashim veechad shichrure avadim, shavu lammolich velammevi. vezo achad min hadderachim sheshshavu gitte nashim leshichrure avadim:
1.5: Kol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti, pasul, chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim. maase, sheheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha vehayu edav ede chutim, vehichshir. kol hashshetarot haolim bearkaot shel goyim, af al pi shechotmehem goyim, kesherim, chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim. rabbi shimon omer, af ellu chesherin, lo huzkeru ella vizman shennaasu vehedyot:
1.6: Haomer, ten get ze leishti ushetar shichrur ze leavdi, im ratza lachazor bishnehen, yachazor, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, begitte nashim, aval lo veshichrure avadim, lefi shezzachin laadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav. sheim yirtze shello lazun et avdo, rashshay. veshello lazun et ishto, eno rashshay. amar lahem, vahare hu fosel et avdo min hatteruma keshem shehu fosel et ishto. amru lo, mippene shehu kinyano. haomer, tenu get ze leishti, ushetar shichrur ze leavdi, umet, lo yittenu leachar mita. tenu mane leish peloni, umet, yittenu leachar mita:

2.1: Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam veamar, befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam, befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav, befanay nichtav kullo uvefanay nechtam chetzyo, befanay nichtav chetzyo uvefanay nechtam kullo, pasul. echad omer befanay nichtav, veechad omer befanay nechtam, pasul. shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav, veechad omer befanay nechtam, pasul. verabbi yehuda machshir. echad omer befanay nichtav, ushenayim omrim befanenu nechtam, kasher:
2.2: Nichtav bayyom venechtam bayyom, ballayla venechtam ballayla, ballayla venechtam bayyom, kasher. bayyom venechtam ballayla, pasul. rabbi shimon machshir, shehaya rabbi shimon omer, kol haggittin shennichtevu vayyom venechtemu vallayla, pesulin, chutz miggitte nashim:
2.3: Bakkol kotvin, bidyo, besam, besikra, uvekomos, uvekankantom, uvechol davar shehu shel keyama. en kotvin lo vemashkim, velo veme ferot, velo vechol davar sheeno mitkayyem. al hakkol kotvin, al heale shel zayit, veal hakkeren shel para, venoten lah et happara, al yad shel eved, venoten lah et haaved. rabbi yose haggelili omer, en kotvin lo al davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, velo al hoochalin:
2.4: En kotvin bimchubbar lakkarka. ketavo vimchubbar, telasho vachatamo unetano lah, kasher. rabbi yehuda fosel, ad shettehe chetivato vachatimato betalush. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer, en kotvin lo al hanneyar hammachuk velo al haddiftera, mippene shehu yachol lehizdayyef. vachachamim machshirin:
2.5: Hakkol kesherin lichtov et hagget, afillu cheresh, shote vekatan. haishsha chotevet et gittah, vehaish kotev et shovro, sheen kiyyum hagget ella vechotmav. hakkol kesherin lehavi et hagget, chutz mecheresh, shote vekatan vesuma venachri:
2.6: Kibbel hakkatan vehigdil, cheresh venitpakkeach, suma venitpatteach, shote venishtappa, nachri venitgayyer, pasul. aval pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach, patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach, shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa, kasher. ze hakkelal, kol shettechillato vesofo vedaat, kasher:
2.7: Af hannashim sheenan neemanot lomar met balah, neemanot lehavi et gittah, chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat balah. ma ben get lemita, shehakketav mochiach. haishsha atzmah mevia et gittah, uvilvad shehi tzericha lomar, befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:

3.1: Kol get shennichtav shello leshum ishsha, pasul. ketzad. haya over bashshuk veshama kol sofrim makrin, ish peloni megaresh et pelonit mimmakom peloni, veamar, ze shemi veze shem ishti, pasul legaresh bo. yater mikken, katav legaresh bo et ishto venimlach, metzao ven iro veamar lo, shemi chishmecha veshem ishti cheshem ishtecha, pasul legaresh bo. yater mikken, hayu lo shete nashim ushemotehen shavot, katav legaresh bo et haggedola, lo yegaresh bo et hakketanna. yater mikken, amar lallavlar, ketov leezo sheertze agaresh, pasul legaresh bo:
3.2: Hakkotev tafse gittin, tzarich sheyyanniach mekom haish umekom haishsha umekom hazzeman. shetare milve, tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hammalve, mekom hallove, mekom hammaot umekom hazzeman. shetare mikkach, tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hallokeach umekom hammocher umekom hammaot umekom hassade umekom hazzeman, mippene hattakkana. rabbi yehuda fosel bechullan. rabbi elazar machshir bechullan, chutz miggitte nashim, shenneemar (Devarim kad) vechatav lah, lishmah:
3.3: Hammevi get veavad hemennu, metzao lealtar, kasher. veim lav, pasul. metzao vachafisa o vidluskema, im makkiro, kasher. hammevi get vehinnicho zaken o chole, notno lah bechezkat shehu kayyam. bat yisrael hannesua lechohen vehalach balah limdinat hayyam, ochelet batteruma vechezkat shehu kayyam. hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam, makrivin otah bechezkat shehu kayyam:
3.4: Shelosha devarim amar rabbi elazar ben parta lifne chachamim vekiyyemu et devarav. al ir shehikkifah karkom, veal hassefina hammittarefet bayyam, veal hayyotze liddon, shehen bechezkat kayyamin. aval ir shekkevashah karkom, usefina sheavda vayyam, vehayyotze lehareg, notnin alehen chumre chayyim vechumre metim, bat yisrael lechohen, uvat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma:
3.5: Hammevi get beeretz yisrael vechala, hare ze meshallecho veyad acher. veim amar lo tol li hemenna chefetz peloni, lo yeshallechennu veyad acher, sheen retzono sheyyehe fikdono veyad acher:
3.6: Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam vechala, ose vet din umeshallecho, veomer lifnehem, befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. veen shaliach acharon tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, ella omer, sheliach bet din ani:
3.7: Hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani lihyot mafrish alehen mechelkan, mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin, veeno choshesh shemma met hakkohen o hallevi o heeshir heani. metu, tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshin. im hilvan bifne vet din, eno tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshim:
3.8: Hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehen teruma umaasrot, maot lihyot mafrish alehen maaser sheni, mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin. im avdu, hare ze choshesh meet leet, divre rabbi elazar ben shammua. rabbi yehuda omer, bishlosha ferakim bodkin et hayyayin, bekadim shel motzae hechag, uvehotzaat semadar, uvishat kenisat mayim babboser:

4.1: Hashsholeach get leishto vehiggia bashshaliach, o sheshshalach acharav shaliach veamar lo, get shennatatti lecha batel hu, hare ze vatel. kadam etzel ishto o sheshshalach etzlah shaliach veamar lah, get sheshshalachti lich batel hu, hare ze vatel. im mishshehiggia get leyadah, shuv eno yachol levattelo:
4.2: Barishona haya ose vet din bemakom acher umevattelo. hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shello yehu osin ken, mippene tikkun haolam. barishona haya meshanne shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah. vehitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyehe chotev, ish peloni vechol shem sheyyesh lo, ishsha felonit vechol shum sheyyesh lah, mippene tikkun haolam:
4.3: En almana nifraat minnichse yetomim ella vishvua. nimneu millehashbiah, hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shettehe noderet laytomim kol ma sheyyirtzu, vegova chetubbatah. haedim chotmin al hagget, mippene tikkun haolam. hillel hitkin perozbul mippenne tikkun haolam:
4.4: Eved shennishba ufedauhu, im leshum eved, yishtabed. im leshum ben chorin, lo yishtabed. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ben kach uven kach yishtabed. eved sheasao rabbo appotiki laacherim veshichrero, shurat haddin, en haeved chayyav kelum. ella mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ven chorin, vechotev shetar al damav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, eno chotev ella meshachrer:
4.5: Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin, oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad, divre vet hillel. amru lahem bet shammay, tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem. lissa shifcha i efshar, shekkevar chetzyo ven chorin. bat chorin i efshar, shekkevar chetzyo aved. yibbatel, vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya velirviyya, shenneemar (yeshaya ma) lo tohu veraah, lashevet yetzarah. ella mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ven chorin, vechotev shetar al chatzi damav. vechazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
4.6: Hammocher avdo legoy o lechutza laaretz, yatza ven chorin. en podin et hashshevuyim yoter al kede demehen, mippene tikkun haolam. veen mavrichin et hashshevuyin, mippene tikkun haolam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, mippene takkanat hashshevuyin. veen lokchim sefarim, tefillin umezuzot min haggoyim yoter al kede demehen, mippene tikkun haolam:
4.7: Hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra, lo yachazir. mishshum neder, lo yachazir. rabbi yehuda omer, kol neder sheyyadu vo rabbim, lo yachazir. veshello yadu vo rabbim, yachazir. rabbi meir omer, kol neder shetztzarich chakirat chacham, lo yachazir. vesheeno tzarich chakirat chacham, yachazir. amar rabbi eliezer, lo asru ze ella mippene ze. amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, maase vetzaydan beechad sheamar leishto, konam im eni megarshech, vegershah. vehittiru lo chachamim sheyyachazirenna, mippene tikkun haolam:
4.8: Hammotzi et ishto mishshum aylonit, rabbi yehuda omer, lo yachazir. vachachamim omrim, yachazir. nisset leacher vehayu lah banim hemennu, vehi tovaat ketubbatah, amar rabbi yehuda, omrim lah, shetikutich yafa lich middibburich:
4.9: Hammocher et atzmo veet banav legoy, en podin oto, aval podin et habbanim leachar mitat avihen. hammocher sadehu legoy vechazar ulekachah mimmennu yisrael, hallokeach mevi mimmennu vikkurim, mippene tikkun haolam:

5.1: Hannizzakin shamin lahem beiddit uvaal chov bevenonit, uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit. rabbi meir omer, af ketubbat ishsha bevenonit:
5.2: En nifrain minnechasim meshubadim bimkom sheyyesh nechasim bene chorin, vaafillu hen zibburit. en nifrain minnichse yetomim, ella min hazzibburit:
5.3: En motziin laachilat perot uleshevach karkaot velimzon haishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshubadim, mippene tikkun haolam. vehammotze metzia, lo yishshava, mippene tikkun haolam:
5.4: Yetomim shessamchu etzel baal habbayit o shemminna lahen avihen appotroppos, chayyav leasser perotehen. appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim, yishshavea. minnahu vet din, lo yishshavea. abba shaul omer, chilluf haddevarim. hametamme vehamedammea vehamenassech beshogeg, patur. bemezid, chayyav. hakkohanim sheppiggelu vammikdash mezidin, chayyavin:
5.5: Heid rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha, shehi yotza veget. veal ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen, sheochelet batteruma, veim meta, balah yorshah. veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao vabbira, sheyyittol et damav, mippene takkanat hashshavim. veal chattat haggezula shello noda larabbim, shehi mechapperet, mippene tikkun hammizbeach:
5.6: Lo haya sikarikon bihuda vaharuge milchama. meharuge milchama veelach, yesh bah sikarikon. ketzad. lakach missikarikon vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit, mikkacho vatel. mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach missikarikon, mikkacho kayyam. lakach min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha, mikkacho vatel. min haishsha vechazar velakach min haish, mikkacho kayyam. zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehem amru, hallokeach missikarikon noten labbealim revia. ematay, bizman sheen beyadan likkach. aval yesh beyadan likkach, hen kodmin lechol adam. rabbi hoshiv bet din venimnu, sheim shahata vifne sikarikon shenem asar chodesh, kol hakkodem likkach, zoche, aval noten labbealim revia:
5.7: Cheresh romez venirmaz. uven betera omer, kofetz venikpatz, bemittaltelin. happaotot, mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar, bemittaltelin:
5.8: Veellu devarim amru mippene darche shalom. kohen kore rishon, veacharav levi veacharav yisrael, mippene darche shalom. mearvin bevayit yashan, mippene darche shalom. bor shehu karov laamma, mitmalle rishon, mippene darche shalom. metzudot chayya veofot vedagim yesh bahem mishshum gazel, mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer, gazel gamur. metziat cheresh shote vekatan, yesh bahen mishshum gazel, mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer, gazel gamur. ani hamenakkef berosh hazzayit, ma shettachtav gazel, mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer, gazel gamur. en memachin beyad aniyye goyim beleket shichcha ufea, mippene darche shalom:
5.9: Mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit, nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur, aval lo tavor velo titchan immah. eshet chaver mashelet leeshet am haaretz, nafa uchevara, uvoreret vetochenet umarkedet immah, aval mishshettattil hammayim, lo tigga immah, lefi sheen machazikin yede ovre avera. vechullan lo amru ella mippene darche shalom. umachazikin yede goyim bashsheviit, aval lo yede yisrael, veshoalin bishloman, mippene darche shalom:

6.1: Haomer hitkabbel get ze leishti o holech get ze leishti, im ratza lachazor, yachazor. haishsha sheamra, hitkabbel li gitti, im ratza lachazor, lo yachazor. lefichach, im amar lo habbaal, i efshi shettekabbel lah ella holech veten lah, im ratza lachazor, yachazor. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af haomeret tol li gitti, im ratza lachazor, lo yachazor:
6.2: Haishsha sheamra, hitkabbel li gitti, tzericha shete chitte edim, shenayim sheomrim befanenu amra ushenayim sheomrim befanenu kibbel vekara, afillu hen harishonim vehen haacharonim, o echad min harishonim veechad min haacharonim veechad mitztaref immahen. naara hameorasa, hi veaviha mekabbelin et gittah. amar rabbi yehuda, en shete yadayim zochot keachat, ella aviha mekabbel et gittah bilvad. vechol sheenah yechola lishmor et gittah, enah yechola lehitgaresh:
6.3: Ketanna sheamra hitkabbel li gitti, eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. lefichach im ratza habbaal lachazor, yachazor, sheen katan ose shaliach. aval im amar lo aviha, tze vehitkabbel levitti gittah, im ratza lehachazir, lo yachazir. haomer ten get ze leishti vemakom peloni, unetano lah bemakom acher, pasul. hare hi vemakom peloni, unetano lah bemakom acher, kasher. haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li gitti vemakom peloni, vekibbelo lah bemakom acher, pasul. rabbi eliezer machshir. have li gitti mimmakom peloni vehevio lah mimmakom acher, kasher:
6.4: Have li gitti, ochelet batteruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. hitkabbel li gitti, asura leechol batteruma miyyad. hitkabbel li gitti vemakom peloni, ochelet batteruma ad sheyyaggia get leoto makom. rabbi eliezer oser miyyad:
6.5: Haomer, kitvu get utenu leishti, garshuha, kitvu iggeret utenu lah, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. pitruha, parnesuha, asu lah kannimmos, asu lah karauy, lo amar kelum. barishona hayu omrim, hayyotze vekolar veamar, kitvu get leishti, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar, af hamefaresh vehayyotze vishyara. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af hammesukkan:
6.6: Mi shehaya mushlach levor veamar, kol hashshomea et kolo yichtov get leishto, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. habbari sheamar, kitvu get leishti, ratza lesachek bah. maase bevari echad sheamar, kitvu get leishti, veala lerosh haggag venafal umet. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, amru chachamim, im meatzmo nafal, hare ze get. im haruach dechaattu, eno get:
6.7: Amar lishnayim, tenu get leishti, o lishlosha, kitvu get utenu leishti, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. amar lishlosha, tenu get leishti, hare ellu yomru laacherim veyichtevu, mippene sheasaan bet din, divre rabbi meir. vezo halacha heela rabbi chanina ish ono mibbet haasurin, mekubbal ani beomer lishlosha, tenu get leishti, sheyyomru laacherim veyichtevu, mippene sheasaan bet din. amar rabbi yose, numenu lashshaliach, af anu mekubbalin, sheafillu amar levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim, tenu get leishti, sheyyilmedu veyichtevu veyittenu. amar laasara, kitvu get leishti, echad kotev ushenayim chotmin. kullechem ketovu, echad kotev vechullam chotmin. lefichach, im met echad mehen, hare ze get batel:

7.1: Mi sheachazo kurdeyakos, veamar, kitvu get leishti, lo amar kelum. amar, kitvu get leishti, vaachazo kurdeyakos, vechazar veamar, al tichtovu, en devarav haacharonim kelum. nishtattek, veamru lo nichtov get leishtecha, vehirkin berosho, bodkin oto shelosha feamim, im amar al lav lav veal hen hen, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu:
7.2: Amru lo, nichtov get leishtecha, veamar lahem ketovu, amru lassofer vechatav, velaedim vechatmu, af al pi shekketavuhu vachatamuhu unetanuhu lo vechazar unetano lah, hare hagget batel, ad sheyyomar lassofer ketov velaedim chatomu:
7.3: Ze gittech im matti, ze gittech im matti mecholi ze, ze gittech leachar mita, lo amar kelum. mehayyom im matti, meachshav im matti, hare ze get. mehayyom uleachar mita, get veeno get. im met, choletzet velo mityabbemet. ze gittech mehayyom im matti mecholi ze, veamad vehilech bashshuk vechala umet, omdin oto, im mechamat choli harishon met, hare ze get. veim lav, eno get:
7.4: Lo tityached immo ella vifne edim, afillu eved, afillu shifcha, chutz mishshifchatah, mippene shellibbah gas bah beshifchatah. ma hi veotan hayyamim. rabbi yehuda omer, keeshet ish lechol devareha. rabbi yose omer, megoreshet veenah megorashet:
7.5: Hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz, hare zo megoreshet, vetitten. al menat shettitteni li mikkan vead sheloshim yom, im natna lo vetoch sheloshim yom, megoreshet, veim lav, ena megoreshet. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, maase vetzaydan beechad sheamar leishto, hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li itzteliti, veavda itztelito, veamru chachamim, titten lo et dameha:
7.6: Hare ze gittech al menat shetteshammeshi et abba, al menat shetteniki et beni, kamma hi menikato, shete shanim. rabbi yehuda omer, shemona asar chodesh. met habben o shemmet haav, hare ze get. hare ze gittech al menat shetteshammeshi et abba shete shanim, al menat shetteniki et beni shete shanim, met habben o shemmet haav o sheamar haav i efshi shetteshammesheni, shello vehakepada, eno get. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kaze get. kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, kol akkava sheenah hemenna, hare ze get:
7.7: Hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan vead sheloshim yom, vehaya holech mihuda laggalil, higgia leantippatres vechazar, batel tenao. hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan ad sheloshim yom, vehaya holech miggalil lihuda, vehiggia lichfar otnay vechazar, batel tenao. hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan ad sheloshim yom, vehaya holech limdinat hayyam vehiggia leakko vechazar, batel tenao. hare ze gittech kol zeman sheeevor mikkeneged panayich sheloshim yom, haya holech uva, holech uva, hoil velo nityached immah, hare ze get:
7.8: Hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh, umet betoch shenem asar chodesh, eno get. hare ze gittech meachshav im lo vati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh, umet betoch shenem asar chodesh, hare ze get:
7.9: Im lo vati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh kitvu utenu get leishti, katvu get betoch shenem asar chodesh venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh, eno get. kitvu utenu get leishti im lo vati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh, katvu vetoch shenem asar chodesh venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh, eno get. rabbi yose omer, kaze get. katvu leachar shenem asar chodesh venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh umet, im hagget kadam lammita, hare ze get. veim mita kadma lagget, eno get. veim en yadua, zo hi sheamru, megoreshet veenah megorashet:

8.1: Hazzorek get leishto vehi vetoch betah o vetoch chatzerah, hare zo megoreshet. zerako lah betoch beto o vetoch chatzero, afillu hu immah bammitta, enah megoreshet. letoch chekah o letoch kaltah, hare zo megorashet:
8.2: Amar lah, kinsi shetar chov ze, o shemmetzaato meachorav, kora vahare hu gittah, eno get, ad sheyyomar lah, he gittech. natan beyadah vehi yeshena, neora, kora vahare hu gittah, eno get, ad sheyyomar lah he ze gittech. hayta omedet birshut harabbim uzerako lah, karov lah, megoreshet. karov lo, enah megoreshet. mechetza al mechetza, megoreshet veenah megorashet:
8.3: Vechen leinyan kiddushin. vechen leinyan hachov. amar lo baal chovo, zerok li chovi, uzerako lo, karov lammalve, zacha hallove. karov lallove, hallove chayyav. mechetza al mechetza, shenehem yachaloku. hayta omedet al rosh haggag uzerako lah, kevan shehiggia laavir haggag, hare zo megoreshet. hu milmala vehi millematta uzerako lah, kevan sheyyatza mershut haggag, nimchak o nisraf, hare zo megorashet:
8.4: Bet shammay omrim, poter adam et ishto veget yashan. uvet hillel osrin. veezehu get yashan, kol shennityached immah achar shekketavo lah:
8.5: Katav leshum malchut sheenah hogenet, leshum malchut maday, leshum malchut yavan, levinyan habbayit, lechurban habbayit, haya vammizrach vechatav bammaarav, bammaarav vechatav bammizrach, tetze mizze umizze, utzericha get mizze umizze, veen lah lo chetubba velo ferot velo mezonot velo velaot, lo al ze velo al ze. im natla mizze umizze, tachazir. vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. velo ze vaze mittammein lah, velo ze vaze zakkain lo vimtziatah velo vemaase yadeha velo vahafarat nedareha. hayta vat yisrael, nifselet min hakkehunna. bat levi, min hammaaser. bat kohen, min hatteruma. veen yorshav shel ze veyorshav shel ze yorshin ketubbatah. veim metu, achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyabbemin. shinna shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah:
8.6: Kol haarayot sheamru tzarotehen muttarot, halchu hatztzarot haellu venisseu venimtzeu ellu ayloniyyot, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah:
8.7: Hakkones et yevimto vehalcha tzaratah venisset leacher venimtzea zot shehi aylonit, tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu vah:
8.8: Katav sofer get laish veshover laishsha, vetaa venatan get laishsha veshover laish, venatnu ze laze, uleachar zeman hare hagget yotze miyyad haish, veshover miyyad haishsha, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah. rabbi eliezer omer, im lealtar yatza, en ze get. im leachar zeman yatza, hare ze get. lo chol hemennu min harishon leabbed zechuto shel sheni. katav legaresh et ishto venimlach, bet shammay omrim, pesalah min hakkehunna. uvet hillel omrim, af al pi shennetano lah al tenay velo naasa hattenay, lo fesalah min hakkehunna:
8.9: Hamegaresh et ishto velana immo befundeki, bet shammay omrim, enah tzerichah hemennu get sheni. uvet hillel omrim, tzericha hemennu get sheni. ematay, bizman shennitgarsha min hannissuin. umodim benitgarsha min haerusin sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni, mippene sheen libbo gas bah. kenasah beget kereach, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah:
8.10: Get kereach, hakkol mashlimin alav, divre ven nannas. rabbi akiva omer, en mashlimin alav ella kerovim haruyin lehaid bemakom acher. veezehu get kereach. kol shekkesharav merubbin meedav:

9.1: Hamegaresh et ishto veamar lah, hare at mutteret lechol adam ella lifloni, rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin. ketzad yaase. yittelennu hemenna veyachazor veyittenennu lah veyomar lah hare at mutteret lechol adam. veim ketavo vetocho, af al pi shechazar umechako, pasul:
9.2: Hare at mutteret lechol adam ella leabba uleavich, leachi uleachich, leeved ulenachri, ulechol mi sheen lah alav kiddushin, kasher. hare at mutteret lechol adam, ella almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, ulechol mi sheyyesh lah alav kiddushin afillu vaavera, pasul:
9.3: Gufo shel get, hare at mutteret lechol adam. rabbi yehuda omer, veden deyeheve lichi minnay sefer teruchin veiggeret shibbukin veget pitturin, limhach lehitnesava lechol gevar detitzbayin. gufo shel get shichrur, hare at bat chorin, hare at leatzmech:
9.4: Shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nisset, havvalad kasher. katav bichtav yado veen alav edim, yesh alav edim veen bo zeman, yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad, hare ellu shelosha gittin pesulin. veim nisset, havvalad kasher. rabbi elazar omer, af al pi sheen alav edim ella shennetano lah bifne edim, kasher vegova minnechasim meshubadim, sheen haedim chotmin al hagget ella mippene tikkun haolam:
9.5: Shenayim sheshshalchu shene gittin shavin venitarvu, noten shenehem lazo ushenehem lazo. lefichach, avad achad mehen, hare hashsheni vatel. chamishsha shekkatvu chelal betoch hagget, ish peloni megaresh pelonit ufeloni pelonit, vehaedim millematta, kullan kesherin, veyinnaten lechol achat veechat. haya chatuv tofes lechol achat veachat, vehaedim millematta, et shehaedim nikrin immo, kasher:
9.6: Shene gittin shekketavan ze vetzad ze ushenayim edim ivrim baim mittachat ze letachat ze ushenayim edim yevanim baim mittachat ze letachat ze, et shehaedim harishonim nikrain immo, kasher. ed echad ivri veed echad yevani, ed echad ivri veed echad yevani bain mittachat ze letachat ze, shenehen pesulin:
9.7: Shiyyer miktzat hagget uchetavo vaddaf hashsheni, vehaedim millematta, kasher. chatmu edim berosh haddaf, min hatztzad, o meacharav beget pashut, pasul. hikkif rosho shel ze vetzad rosho shel ze, vehaedim baemtza, shenehem pesulin. sofo shel ze vetzad sofo shel ze, vehaedim baemtza, et shehaedim nikrin immo, kasher. rosho shel ze vetzad sofo shel ze, vehaedim baemtza, et shehaedim nikrin besofo, kasher:
9.8: Get shekketavo ivrit veedav yevanit, yevanit veedav ivrit, ed echad ivri veed echad yevani, katav sofer veed, kasher. ish peloni ed, kasher. ben ish peloni ed, kasher. ish peloni ben ish peloni, velo chatav ed, kasher. vechach hayu nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin. katav chanichato vachanichatah, kasher. get meusse, beyisrael, kasher. uvegoyim, pasul. uvegoyim, chovtin oto veomrim lo ase ma sheyyisrael omrim lecha, vechasher:
9.9: Yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet, hare zo mekuddeshet. megoreshet, hare zo megoreshet. uvilvad shello yehe sham amatla. ezo hi amatla. gerash ish peloni et ishto al tenay, zarak lah kiddusheha, safek karov lah safek karov lo, zo hi amatla:
9.10: Bet shammay omrim, lo yegaresh adam et ishto ella im ken matza vah devar erva, shenneemar (Devarim kad), ki matza vah ervat davar. uvet hillel omrim, afillu hikdicha tavshilo, shenneemar (sham), ki matza vah ervat davar. rabbi akiva omer, afillu matza acheret naa hemenna, shenneemar (sham), vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav:
